lines.text: Maya said yes to a ten-mile hike with friends.
Her longest hike so far was three miles.
On the first climb her legs burned and she kept stopping.
Here's the fix. Start training weeks before.
Five short sessions a week: walks, hills and simple strength moves like step-ups.
Add a little distance each week, never all at once.
On the next big day, she reached the top with her friends.
Save this before you book your next big hike.
